messages.subject: For Harvey Schwartz | Private capital, government relations and portfolio stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Harris,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Harvey Schwartz, Chief Executive Officer.

Carlyle's global private-capital platform spans sectors and markets where government relationships, regulation and operating execution matter directly to value creation. That intersection aligns strongly with my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market operating experience might support Carlyle's portfolio or regional priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to The Carlyle Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
